app.title: AgriTwin Rwanda
app.tagline: Actual yield versus the modeled attainable yield, by district.
app.footer: AgriTwin Rwanda. NISR 2026 Big Data Hackathon. Not official NISR statistics.

map.legendSuppressed: Grey: too few surveyed plots to report reliably
map.reliabilityNote: Reliability: {{reliability}}. Too few surveyed plots for a precise estimate.
map.noData: No data for {{crop}} in Season {{season}} {{year}} here.

district.yieldTrendCaption: Weighted district-level actual yield for {{crop}}, Season {{season}}, by year.
district.yieldTrendEmpty: No years with usable data for this crop and season.
district.gapTrendCaption: Actual yield versus modeled attainable yield: how much room this district has to close the gap.
district.gapTrendEmpty: No years with a computed gap for this crop and season.
district.driversCaption: SHAP-based associations from the driver model, not causal effects (per project rule: "associated with", never "causes" or "increases yield by").
district.driversEmpty: Not enough data to rank drivers for this district.
district.nowcastCaption: A leave-one-year-out backtest prediction, {{lead}} months into the season, not a live in-season forecast: every row served today is historical hold-out data.
district.nowcastEmpty: No early estimate for {{crop}} in Season {{season}} {{year}} at this lead time.
district.modelUsedNote: Model used: {{model}}, chosen because it had the lowest backtest error for this crop and lead time — often the simple district-average baseline, not a fancier model. See the methodology page for the full honest comparison.
district.scenarioCaption: Model-based estimate of mean yield under a hypothetical combination of practices, not a simulation of a real intervention.
district.scenarioEmpty: No scenario data for this district and crop.
district.peersCaption: Same modeled agro-ecological zone (a k-means grouping, since no real AEZ layer is configured in this project).
district.briefCaption: A one-page PDF covering all 4 MVP crops for this district, generated ahead of time.
